name: Goldman Sachs

Analyst.dsaDepth: Heavy - CoderPad/HackerRank screen (2–3 problems), then a multi-round SuperDay
rounds: Recruiter/HR screen (~30 min, fit and background)
CoderPad phone screen (1–2 coding problems, easy–medium)
SuperDay: 3–6 back-to-back rounds covering DSA/coding, low- and high-level design, SDLC practices, and behavioral
extraTopics: SDLC and engineering-practice questions (testing, code review, CI/CD)

Associate.dsaDepth: Heavy - same SuperDay format, more design and past-project weight
rounds: SuperDay: coding, system design (HLD+LLD), and a deeper resume/project deep-dive across several rounds
extraTopics: System design at a securities-firm scale
Leading and justifying past technical decisions

VP.dsaDepth: Moderate - coding still present, design and leadership dominate
rounds: SuperDay: fewer pure-coding rounds, more system design, architecture and people-leadership discussion
VP.notes: Process for VP+ is thinner in public reports than Analyst/Associate.

ladder.title: Managing Director
ladder.notes: Senior-most; a small fraction of engineers reach this title
